title: Never-show list
description: The never-show list at profile paths.never_show (scripts/CONTRACTS.md 6.1b), one JSON file shared with /execution: /execution's banned-phrase grep reads entries of scope repo or both before every commit and before the public flip; /frontend's coverage.nevershow reads entries of scope rendered or both on rendered text. An entry whose until_utc is in the past is inactive. An embargo always carries its end date.

pattern.description: A literal substring, or, when regex is true, a regular expression in the subset JavaScript and Python re read the same way (Q-F9): character classes, quantifiers, alternation, non-capturing groups, lookahead, anchors, \b \d \w \s; never named groups, lookbehind, backreferences, inline flags, atomic groups, possessive quantifiers, \A \Z \z, \p{...} or \c. Matching folds NFKC then lower-case on both sides when case_sensitive is false, and a regex entry then gets the ignore-case flag.

until_utc.description: UTC end of the entry; null means it never expires.

source.description: The file (and line when known) the entry comes from, for example a memory note or a redaction file.

allOf.description: An embargo has an end date.

A regex entry stays inside the JavaScript and Python common subset (Q-F9, agreed with /execution 2026-10-01): no lookbehind, named group, inline flag, atomic, comment or conditional group, no backreference, \A \Z \z, Unicode property or \c escape, no class that starts with ] ([] or [^]). lib/text.mjs neverShowRegexProblem() is the escape-aware check the gates run; this pattern is its textual approximation, so a validator in either language refuses the same entries.
